description:
Sets the paragraph line spacing. If the value of the sLineRule parameter is either 
"atLeast" or "exact", then the value of nLine will be interpreted as twentieths of a point. If 
the value of the sLineRule parameter is "auto", then the value of the 
nLine parameter will be interpreted as 240ths of a line.

params.description: The line spacing value measured either in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch) or in 240ths of a line.
params.name: nLine

params.description: The rule that determines the measuring units of the line spacing.
params.name: sLineRule
